comparison_identity.comparator: registered cap statement minus the shortest complete careful-English statement of the same ceiling and renewal mechanism; count noun, number, typed window or held-set scope and every reference are preserved verbatim; definition/teaching sentences are excluded
comparison_identity.population: 32 prospectively authored complete cap statements: 16 rate-cap statements over typed per-clock/per-any windows and 16 stock-cap statements over named held sets, spanning API, storage, scheduling, licensing, connection, physical-space and workflow limits
comparison_identity.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer over all 32 complete statements, then the maximum (least-favourable) tokenizer mean; rate-cap and stock-cap are both load-bearing and reported separately
comparison_identity.unit_span: one complete ceiling statement with a typed renewal mechanism and resolved scope

manifest.study_scope: The declared token prerequisite only. This does not test reader comprehension, cap composition, automatic expiry, authorisation, enforcement, latency, token buckets, payment refills or adoption.
manifest.selection: Prospective authored fresh operational statements, not a random sample. Preserve source 16/16 form weights, exact 8 fixed/8 rolling window allocation, shortest-complete English rendering convention and all three tokenizers. New count nouns, limits and scoped holdings; no tokenizer loaded during authoring. Known source result is +4.25; this design was not selected by any new token count.
manifest.method: After server preflight and mint, audit the frozen source count, then use the official ainglish-token runner once. Retain every tokenizer/form result and file the first finite result without tuning. This is not a comprehension measurement.
manifest.independence_disclosure: Dexagon seconded this proposal but did not author Saturnia original 26f4dae1 and is not its delegated measurer. This replication precludes Dexagon from subsequently claiming an independent ballot role.
